title: Fields in practitioner_account_sources.csv
description: One row per public source attached to a practitioner-survey account.

columns.source_id: Stable source identifier; unique and nonempty.
columns.author: Named source author(s).
columns.title: Source title.
columns.first_person: yes/no/unclear: whether the source directly reports the practitioner workflow.
columns.public_artifact: yes/no/unclear: whether a public formalization/code artifact is linked or provided.
columns.build_provenance_available: yes/no/unclear: whether build/toolchain/transcript/history provenance is publicly available.
columns.supports_account_observation: yes/partial/no: whether this source supports the coded account observation.
columns.evidence_scope: Short description of which account evidence this source supports.
